fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the approaching 1927–1928 winter tourist season in Greater Miami, warning against price gouging and criticizing the defeat of a municipal auditorium bond issue. Coverage includes disputes involving Florida Power & Light (including meter concerns and criticism of utility promotional leaflets), complaints about local transportation and noise from buses, notes on political races and civic affairs, and announcements tied to seasonal openings such as the Everglades Hotel. Also includes assorted columns, advertisements, and community items referencing Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, and Hialeah.
